from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/lucky/devdir/rgzndl');folder=ROOT/'results/experiments/paper_bn_recalibration_v1';out=folder/'results_acceptance_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(p,v):Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',newline='\n')
reviewpath=Path('/tmp/ect_bn_results_independent_review.json');review=json.loads(reviewpath.read_text())
assert review['status']=='checked_pass' and not review['errors'] and review['maximum_numeric_absolute_error']<=1e-12
assert review['checked_counts']['new_prediction_rows']==81600 and review['checked_counts']['original_prediction_rows']==81600
assert not (out/'acceptance.json').exists()
contexts=json.loads((out/'review_context_snapshots.json').read_text())
for kind in ['input_sha256','output_sha256']:
 for label,digest in review[kind].items():
  p=Path(label)
  if kind=='output_sha256' and not p.is_absolute() and not label.startswith(('results/','docs/')):
   p=folder/'analysis_results_v1'/p
  else:
   p=p if p.is_absolute() else ROOT/p
  if sha(p)!=digest:
   snapshot=contexts.get(label)
   assert snapshot is not None,label
   assert sha(ROOT/snapshot['snapshot_path'])==digest,label
summary=json.loads((folder/'analysis_results_v1/summary.json').read_text())
for label,digest in summary['inputs_sha256'].items():assert sha(ROOT/label)==digest,label
for label,digest in summary['outputs_sha256'].items():assert sha(folder/'analysis_results_v1'/label)==digest,label
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(reviewpath,out/'independent_review.json')
proofs=[]
for seed in range(3):
 p=folder/'verification'/f'resnext_s{seed}_cuda.json';r=json.loads(p.read_text())
 assert r['status']=='verified' and r['maximum_metric_error']==0 and r['calibration_buffer_max_abs_error']==0
 assert r['same_device_calibration_exact'] and r['prediction_counts']=={'train':24000,'validation':3200}
 proofs.append(dict(seed=seed,path=p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),sha256=sha(p)))
acceptance=dict(schema_version=1,status='verified',created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),protocol='paper_bn_results_acceptance_v1',
 registry_sha256=sha(folder/'registry.json'),summary_sha256=sha(folder/'analysis_results_v1/summary.json'),
 results_doc_path='docs/paper_bn_recalibration_results.md',results_doc_sha256=sha(ROOT/'docs/paper_bn_recalibration_results.md'),
 independent_review_sha256=sha(out/'independent_review.json'),proofs=proofs,new_prediction_count=81600,
 review_context_snapshots_sha256=sha(out/'review_context_snapshots.json'),
 checks={k:True for k in ['three_registered_complete_runs','calibration_replayed_exactly','non_bn_state_parameters_unchanged',
  'full_prediction_metric_verification','summary_and_group_statistics','gzip_exact_roundtrip','figure_hashes','figures_visually_reviewed',
  'negative_results_all_retained','original_sources_and_weights_unchanged','test_classification_sealed']},
 helper=dict(text=Path(__file__).read_text(),sha256=sha(__file__)))
write(out/'acceptance.json',acceptance)
print(json.dumps(dict(status='verified',independent_checks=review['checked_counts']['checks'],acceptance_sha256=sha(out/'acceptance.json'))))
